Body.Content:
The PPAC Reporting API gives customers scalable, programmatic access to Copilot Studio usage data from our lakehouse, replacing older unsupported methods for pulling consumption data. Daily JSON data by environment, user, agent and feature powers dashboards, FinOps reporting and automated cost controls.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
